test_title: PYST 68: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper sells rice at the rate of ₹44 per kg whose cost price is ₹40 per kg. Not satisfied with this, he tries to increase his profit by removing 200 grams of rice from each packet. What is the shopkeeper's overall gain percentage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Overall Multiplier = Price Multiplier × Weight Multiplier

Price Multiplier = SP ÷ CP = 44 ÷ 40 = 11 ÷ 10

Weight Multiplier = Claimed Weight ÷ Actual Weight = 1000 ÷ 800 = 5 ÷ 4

Overall Multiplier = (11 ÷ 10) × (5 ÷ 4) = 55 ÷ 40 = 11 ÷ 8

Gain % = [(11 − 8) ÷ 8] × 100 = (3 ÷ 8) × 100 = 37.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 37.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d75f8487d96abd595f4fd09fb5c7826adce84b84dac0ed5d16448abe5385b7e.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Cost price (CP) for 1000g rice = ₹40

⇒ Selling price (SP) claimed for 1000g = ₹44

⇒ Weight removed per 1kg packet = 200g

⇒ Actual weight given to customer = 1000 − 200 = 800g

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Profit = SP − CP

⇒ Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Actual cost incurred by shopkeeper for 800g = (40 ÷ 1000) × 800 = ₹32

⇒ Selling price obtained for the 1kg packet = ₹44

⇒ Total Profit earned = 44 − 32 = ₹12

⇒ Overall Profit % = (12 ÷ 32) × 100

⇒ Overall Profit % = (3 ÷ 8) × 100 = 37.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 37.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

When a dealer sells goods at Cost Price but uses false weight, his profit % = [(True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight] × 100.

Successive Profit Multiplier

If there is a markup in price as well as cheating in weight, Overall Multiplier = (SP ÷ CP) × (True Weight ÷ False Weight). Final Profit % = (Overall Multiplier − 1) × 100.

Mark-up and Discount

The selling price can be adjusted by adding a markup on the CP and then giving a discount. Effective SP = CP × (1 + Markup %) × (1 − Discount %).
